inputs.name: gitlab_url
inputs.description: Address of the GitLab instance the runners take jobs from, such as "https://gitlab.example.com".

inputs.name: runner_token
inputs.description: Runner authentication token, starting glrt-, from creating a runner in GitLab. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_runner_token; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: runner_version
inputs.description: GitLab Runner release to install, such as "19.5.2". Raising it upgrades the runner in place. Keep it within a minor release or so of your GitLab.

inputs.name: executor
inputs.description: How the runner runs jobs: "shell", on the host as the gitlab-runner user, or "docker", each job in a container, which needs Docker Engine on the host.

inputs.name: concurrent
inputs.description: Most jobs each host runs at once.

inputs.name: docker_image
inputs.description: Image the docker executor runs a job in when its .gitlab-ci.yml names none.
